configuracion.title: DeCA configuration
configuracion.subtitle: Adjust the public visibility of the QR and the module's notifications.
configuracion.tarjeta_acceso_publico_desc: How long the DeCA stays accessible without login via the QR, and how long the data of whoever downloads it is kept.
configuracion.ayuda_dias_visibilidad: Legal minimum under the DeCA regulation: 7 days. Default: 10.
configuracion.label_dias_retencion_ip: Days of retention of the download IP
configuracion.ayuda_dias_retencion_ip: How long the IP of whoever downloads the DeCA via the QR is kept, for data minimization (GDPR). No legal minimum. Default: 365 days.
configuracion.tarjeta_notificaciones_desc: Choose which channel notifies each party when a DeCA is generated.
configuracion.bloque_conductor_desc: Notifying the driver is always mandatory -- here you only choose the channel.
configuracion.bloque_cliente_desc: Also notify the consignee when the DeCA is generated.
configuracion.bloque_transportista_desc: Also notify the carrier when the DeCA is generated.
configuracion.tarjeta_repositorio_desc: Where the obligation to keep the DeCA comes from, and where to connect an external repository (Google Drive) if you want a copy outside Appodo.
configuracion.repositorio_procedimiento_titulo: What the regulation requires (Resolution of 5 June 2026, BOE-A-2026-12784)
configuracion.repositorio_procedimiento_1: The PDF must be digitally native (never scanned) and under 5 MB.
configuracion.repositorio_procedimiento_2: The QR must download the PDF DIRECTLY when the URL is invoked -- no login, no buttons or intermediate pages.
configuracion.repositorio_procedimiento_3: That login-free access only holds during the window configured above (legal minimum 7 days after the transport ends).
configuracion.repositorio_procedimiento_4: The document must be kept for a full year, even once it's no longer reachable via the public QR -- that's why a copy in your own repository (Drive), not just in Appodo, is worth having.
configuracion.gdrive_deca_desc: Appodo already stores the generated DeCA. This is optional: if you connect Drive and pick a folder, every generated DeCA is also copied there.
configuracion.gdrive_no_configurado: Google Drive integration is not configured in this environment.
configuracion.gdrive_no_conectado_desc: No Google Drive account connected yet for this company.
configuracion.gdrive_se_gestiona_en: the connection is managed from My Account.
configuracion.gdrive_error_carpeta: Could not save the Drive folder.
configuracion.gdrive_elegir_carpeta_ayuda: Pick a folder that already exists in your Drive.
configuracion.gdrive_crear_carpeta_ayuda: Or let Appodo create a new folder dedicated to DeCA.
configuracion.tarjeta_rol_desc: What you usually are in your shipments. It decides which field is pre-filled with your own tax ID and how the tax IDs read by the automatic extraction are assigned. You can always correct it by hand on a given shipment.
configuracion.rol_cargador: Shipper — I dispatch my own goods
configuracion.ayuda_rol_habitual: Issuing the DeCA is an obligation of both at once: the contractual shipper and the effective carrier are jointly liable if it is missing.
configuracion.tarjeta_cabecera_desc: Optional: add a quality-system-style header (code, version, edition...) to the exported Expeditions and Agenda PDFs, instead of the plain title.

agenda.title: Directory
agenda.subtitle: Regular carriers, consignees, drivers and vehicles. It fills itself as you save shipments.
agenda.vacio: No entries yet. They'll be created automatically as you save shipments, or you can add them by hand.
agenda.confirmar_borrado_desc: It is only removed from the directory. Existing shipments do not change: they store the tax ID and name as they were, because they are a legal document.
agenda.importar_desc: CSV with a header row. A row that already exists (same NIF, or same tractor plate for Vehicles) is updated instead of duplicated.
